test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 14 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What will be the total number of days from 20 February 2020 to 15 April 2020, by including both the days?
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

In the month of February remaining day is:- 10 (Because 2020 is the leap year so, the month of February will be 29 Days)

In the month of March remaining day is:- 31

In the month of April the total day is:- 15

The total number of days from 20 February 2020 to 15 April 2020 = **10 + 31 + 15 **= 56<
